subject: Beacon Health — MSA redline workshop and onboarding checklist
messages:
From: Sarah Kim <sarah.kim@beaconhealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Beacon Health — MSA redline workshop and onboarding checklist

Hi Karthik / Laura / Monica,

Thanks for the demo last week — Beacon is excited about Redwood. Procurement has asked that we run a short redline workshop so our legal and security teams can surface any concerns before we move to signatures. We'd also like to walk through a brief vendor onboarding checklist so our IT ops know what to expect for the first 30 days.

High-level asks from our side:
- 60–75 minute working session focused on MSA redlines + security Q&A
- Beacon to share our security questionnaire ahead of time (attached)
- Agree on follow-ups and DocuSign timeline

People who will attend from Beacon: Sarah Kim (Procurement), Tom Walker (Legal), Ramesh Gupta (IT Ops).

Are you available to run a workshop this week or early next week? We can be flexible afternoon PT.

Thanks,
Sarah
Sarah Kim
Senior Procurement Manager | Beacon Health
Attachments: beacon_security_q_2026.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Beacon Health — MSA redline workshop and onboarding checklist

Thanks for the note, Sarah — great to hear Beacon wants to move this along. We can run a focused redline workshop and pair it with a short onboarding checklist review. I attached a one-page preliminary checklist and a suggested agenda to keep us tight.

Proposed slots (PT):
- Tue 2026-06-30 11:00–12:15
- Tue 2026-06-30 14:00–15:15
- Wed 2026-07-01 13:00–14:15

If none of those work, share a couple of windows and we'll adjust. For the workshop we recommend:
- 10m intro + scope
- 35–45m redline review (legal + procurement focus)
- 15m security/ops Q&A (IT specifics + onboarding tasks)
- 10m next steps & timeline for DocuSign

Attachments: redline_checklist_v1.pdf (agenda + checklist)

Best,
Karthik
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Beacon Health — MSA redline workshop and onboarding checklist

Hi Sarah — thanks for sending the security questionnaire. A couple of asks from Legal before the call so we can prepare redlines efficiently:
- Can you flag the top 5 clauses Beacon expects to change (indemnification, data residency, breach notice timelines, liability cap, and audit rights)?
- If Beacon has standard redlines, can you attach them to the thread; otherwise we'll work from your questionnaire and the latest MSA draft.

Availability: Tue 11:00–12:30 PT works best for me; I can do the 14:00 slot if needed but would prefer earlier.

Also confirming we should include a short segment on data retention and logs for compliance. If Beacon can share a preferred retention period that helps.

Monica
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Quick pre-work items:
- Beacon: confirmed top-five clause flags (received) and DocuSign envelope link — thank you.
